title: When the Signal Turns
author: Lena Vane
blurb: Ivo Reyes, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
